articles.title: Strategy holds STRC dividend at 12%
articles.snippet: Customarily, Michael Saylor and team have lifted the STRC dividend when it trades sizably below par, but not this month.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds monthly gain, faces 'choppy' August as 'forced-selling' exhausted, analysts say
articles.snippet: The largest crypto shrugged off a barrage of bad news this month, but traders remain cautious as rate hike fears and jobs data loom.

articles.title: Strategy leaves preferred STRC dividend at 12% as price still below par
articles.snippet: Investors have previously benefited from a payout boost when the preferred STRC shares traded well below their $100 par value for a month.

articles.title: Trump Media sells another 2,628 BTC, holdings fall to 4,261 BTC
articles.snippet: Trump Media transferred another 2,628 Bitcoin to Crypto.com, bringing its reported sales over seven months to 7,281 BTC and leaving the company with 4,261 BTC in holdings.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs end July in the green despite late-month selling
articles.snippet: Spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $172.4 million in July inflows but remained $5.3 billion negative year to date after heavy withdrawals in May and June.
